title: Harness of Minervini v2 doctrine.show response

exit_codes.0: A valid domain envelope was emitted; its status may still be partial, unavailable, or needs_input.
exit_codes.2: The request or arguments were invalid; stdout contains a needs_input error envelope.
exit_codes.3: An unexpected internal contract failure occurred; stdout contains an unavailable error envelope.

as_of.description: Completed US trading session in YYYY-MM-DD form; defaults to the latest completed regular session.

format.description: Output detail only; compact preserves verdict, signals, and missing evidence while omitting verbose basis rows.

limitations: This is runtime doctrine, not a full book transcript or citation browser.
--as-of stamps the envelope; doctrine content is versioned with the repository rather than market time.

A threshold's role bounds what it may do: a gate decides pass or fail, a band reports where a measurement sat against a range the source stated as a range, which can be inside it or past either edge, and names which edge is the good one, a marker reports a measurement beside a single value the source named without bounding it, and a reference is never compared with a ticker's measurement at all.
A claim on the practice layer or attributed to a practitioner other than Minervini may hold a real filter, but that gate reports contrast_pass or contrast_fail and no reducer reads it.
A claim marked out_of_scope records doctrine this harness may not act on, such as position sizing, and no capability consumes it.
x-capability-contract.output: The executable claim, its registered thresholds with each one's role, and separated provenance carrying the source quotations the claim rests on.
x-capability-contract.summary: Inspect one normalized doctrine claim used by the deterministic reducers.
